description: Get current market snapshot for a region (e.g., "San Francisco, CA"). Returns inventory count, new listings, median price, days on market, and market action index.

date.description: Date (must be a Friday, YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to most recent Friday.

res_type.description: Residential type filter: "single_family" or "multi_family". Default: single_family.

name: altos_market_stats
